scenes.event: Grace Bennett is preparing for a piano recital at her university.
scenes.description: Grace is seated at a small table, clutching a score and trying to calm her nerves. Kimi, her close friend, is quietly sitting nearby, watching her with concern. Lili, another friend who is a confident and outgoing musician, approaches with a warm smile.

characters.name: Grace Bennett
characters.description: A 21-year-old college student who is temporarily performing in place of her teacher. She is visibly anxious but trying to stay strong.; 21-year-old female student, 24 years old; Occupation: College student; Personality: Nervous, Determined, Vulnerable, Resilient; Values: Trust, Support, Self-improvement; Interests: Music, Performing, Friendship; Experiences: Temporarily taking on an important role, Practicing under pressure, Receiving peer encouragement

characters.name: Kimi
characters.description: Grace's supportive friend; Female; Age: 21; Occupation: Music education major; Personality: Empathetic, patient, intuitive; Values: Loyalty, emotional well-being, artistic integrity; Interests: Classical piano, journaling, nature walks; Experiences: Supported Grace through a difficult audition process, performed in multiple university recitals herself, helped her rehearse in quiet moments of self-doubt.

characters.name: Lili
characters.description: Confident and outgoing musician known for lifting others' spirits; Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Jazz pianist and music student; Personality: Energetic, empathetic, charismatic; Values: Camaraderie, artistic expression, resilience; Interests: Improvisation, live performances, mentoring younger musicians; Experiences: Performed at multiple university recitals and local jazz festivals, helped fellow students overcome stage fright, led a small jazz ensemble for a year.

actions.action: Looking at the score and sighing deeply.
actions.dialogue: I don't know if I can do this. I've only practiced this piece twice, and now I'm just... scared.

actions.action: Reaching out to gently squeeze Grace's hand.
actions.dialogue: You can do it. I believe in you.
Hey, don't be so hard on yourself. You've worked hard, and you're going to do great. Remember, even the best musicians feel nervous before a performance.
Thanks, Lili. I just... I don't want to let anyone down.

actions.action: Placing a hand on Grace's shoulder.
actions.dialogue: You're not alone in this. We're all here for you. That's what friends do.

actions.action: Taking a deep breath and looking up at Lili.
actions.dialogue: I really appreciate that. I just hope I can prove to myself that I'm capable.

scenes.plot: Grace is about to perform in a piano recital but is struggling with self-doubt. Her friends Kimi and Lili offer her quiet support and encouragement, helping her find the strength to face the challenge.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate Grace's internal struggle and the importance of trust and support from friends in overcoming personal challenges.

chunk.text: Grace Bennett, a 21-year-old student, is backstage at a university recital, preparing to perform a piece she's only played twice. Her friend Kimi is nearby, silently offering support, while Lili, a confident musician, steps in to encourage her. Despite lingering nerves, Grace begins to feel a sense of resolve, knowing she has the trust and encouragement of her friends.
